data.body: **[P2] Exercise the thin-layer runtime before publishing.** This build skips tests and only checks ZIP entries. Existing OTel tests package the plugin and OTel dependencies with the function, so they do not cover dynamic discovery and the agent/application classloader boundary when this plugin JAR is the layer's only JAR. Add a PR-running integration test that builds this ZIP and verifies a traced invocation through `DURABLE_EXECUTION_PLUGINS` and `OTEL_JAVAAGENT_EXTENSIONS`.
